Massive Fire Guts Pune Timber Market, Over 50 Shops Destroyed

A massive fire broke out in Pune's Timber Market, destroying over 50 shops and causing losses estimated in the lakhs. Firefighting efforts involved 27 fire tenders, which eventually brought the blaze under control. Reports indicate that between 50 and 100 shops were gutted.
